bug_semantics: Authenticated Jolokia exec of BrokerView.addNetworkConnector(String)/addConnector(String) accepts discovery URIs. CVE-2026-34197 added a scheme deny-list (vm, later other transports) in BrokerView.validateAllowedUrl/validateAllowedUri, but nested-component inspection is gated on URISupport.isCompositeURI(), which is true only when the scheme-specific part starts with '('. Discovery wrappers such as static: and masterslave: also accept non-parenthesized forms (static:vm://..., masterslave:vm://...,...); URISupport.parseComposite still splits those into inner URIs. The inner vm://...?brokerConfig=xbean:... therefore skips the deny-list, reaches VMTransportFactory, and loads attacker-controlled Spring XML via ResourceXmlApplicationContext before BrokerService validation, yielding RCE (CWE-20/CWE-94). Patched by always calling parseComposite so missing parentheses are walked the same way transports construct the objects.
flaw_origin: The incomplete check was first written as the CVE-2026-34197 mitigation in PR #1840: validateAllowedUrl only walks composite components when isCompositeURI(uri) is true, so non-parenthesized discovery wrappers had only their outer scheme checked. Follow-on #1847/#1900 added nested recursion and a loop-variable fix but kept the same isCompositeURI gate. The first-write is PR member ef53b5b7b7ba2a14e67f1fcbf9126e79625430d0 (identical BrokerView blob to GitHub squash a4c771f2440efb3ae8cb9b9b66483fc2a8c6a249 on main).

Apache advisory: non-parenthesized discovery wrappers such as masterslave:vm://...,... and static:vm://... incorrectly pass validation, bypassing CVE-2026-34197. Affected: before 5.19.7 and 6.0.0 before 6.2.6; upgrade to 5.19.7 or 6.2.6. Mechanism: Jolokia /api/jolokia/ exec on org.apache.activemq:* BrokerService.addNetworkConnector/addConnector with e.g. static:vm://...?brokerConfig=xbean:<url> or masterslave:vm://...,...; VM transport brokerConfig loads ResourceXmlApplicationContext so singleton beans (Runtime.exec/ProcessBuilder) run before broker validation. CVE-2026-34197 blocked parenthesized composites (static:(vm://...)); this CVE is the no-paren residual.

URISupport.isCompositeURI (activemq-client/.../URISupport.java:294 at BIC) returns true only if ssp.indexOf('(')==0 && checkParenthesis(ssp). parseComposite private method else-branch (initialParen!=0) still treats the whole SSP as componentString and splitComponents, so static:vm://... and static:vm://a,vm://b are real composites at runtime but invisible to the validator gate.

reasoning: CVE-2026-45505 is a real, non-withdrawn incomplete-remediation bypass of CVE-2026-34197, not a false positive. The unique sink is BrokerView URI validation that inspects inner discovery/transport schemes only when URISupport.isCompositeURI is true, so non-parenthesized wrappers (static:vm://..., masterslave:vm://...,...) reach VM brokerConfig Spring XML loading. The smallest first-write of that gate is PR #1840 member ef53b5b7b7ba2a14e67f1fcbf9126e79625430d0; the GitHub squash a4c771f is the same patch but is a squash aggregate, so the reconstructed public member is the BIC. Immediate parent bedb10801c4d11e12f61ef8a9d9cf3407be50e97 has addConnector/addNetworkConnector without validateAllowedUrl. #1847/#1900 are later incomplete follow-ons, not first writes. The original no-validator RCE is CVE-2026-34197; this CVE's vulnerable lines are the incomplete check. Fix cf0006041d2c78c4638f5ea513db4d59515998f6 (#2004) replaces the isCompositeURI gate with unconditional parseComposite; cherry-picks c034ea8 and c1b44af land in advisory patched tags 5.19.7 and 6.2.6. BIC commit-object author/committer/trailers have no AI marker, so verdict is NOT_AI.
